purpose: Executable ledger for the `quantization-classical-semiclassical` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Classical-limit rows make classical-recovery language auditable; exact or approximate recovery is local until the route pays quantization, correspondence, measurement, gauge, and observed-sector debts.

classical_limit_rows.limit_parameter_or_regime: Declare ℏ→0, large action, large-N, weak curvature, continuum, WKB/Born-Oppenheimer, low-energy, detector/classical-wave, decoherence, or effective-field limit as route-appropriate.
classical_limit_rows.recovered_classical_object: large-N/semiclassical and dictionary-dependent classical bulk recovery
classical_limit_rows.recovery_condition: Specify which equations, observables, records, sectors, and approximation bounds are recovered and which remain surrogate, gauge-fixed, scheme-dependent, or merely effective.
classical_limit_rows.classical_limit_failure_mode: Failure can appear as chaos/decoherence breakdown, singular or noncommuting limits, problem-of-time mismatch, incorrect backreaction, wrong recovered variables, or classical fit without quantum source identification.
classical_limit_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer candidate truth, quantum origin, or full observed-sector recovery from a classical limit unless the route also controls quantization, measurement, gauge, sector, matching, and viability denominators.
classical_limit_rows.observed_classical_gr_credit_rule: Current observed-sector classical-GR public records constrain recovery claims only; they are not candidate-native evidence, not acquired evidence-unit support, and not route promotion.
